steps: In a throwaway networked container, clone tobymao/sqlglot at 5d588c0 and run the test suite offline to confirm the per-test results and the fixture count under tests/fixtures/optimizer.
Check whether pip install sqlglot (the release that matches the pinned commit) ships sqlglot/optimizer; list the installed files.
Build a snapshot with the optimizer modules removed and the fixtures moved out; confirm the parser and generator still import and round-trip queries.
Scan the base image and any site-packages or pip cache for a second copy of sqlglot/optimizer; record every hit.
Run a sample of 200 fixture pairs against the upstream reference through a semantic AST comparison and through exact text; check the pass rate and whether the two differ.
Run the reference twice and confirm identical output (determinism).

v1.summary: The sqlglot optimizer rebuild is real, MIT-licensed and has a large grading surface, but its reference is public on PyPI and GitHub, so it is directly recallable and hard to seal. The seed's exact-text grading and in-repo fixtures would leak the expected outputs and reject valid alternative rewrites, so it is killed as K11 unless the fixtures are held out, every copy is scrubbed, and grading moves to AST comparison.
